correctness.rationale: The path eigensystem lambda_k=2cos(k pi/9), v_k(i)=sqrt(2/9)sin(ik pi/9), and k<->9-k reflection give the stated cosine/sine amplitude formulas. The displayed 64 strictly positive integer grid weights sum to 256 and give all 32 exact cosine/sine moments; inserting the orthogonal-sine-projector identities yields E[M_ij]=1/8 in all 64 matrix entries. The q=9 spectral relation lambda1=lambda2+lambda4, lambda3=1 and irreducible minimal polynomial X^3-3X+1 for lambda2 imply rational independence of the three torus base frequencies; the positive-time phase orbit is dense. Each mixing coordinate has only 16 nonconstant phase harmonics; the grid image has rank 16 over F109, hence characteristic-zero affine rank 16, so the positive-grid barycenter is in the full relative interior of the torus convex hull. Dense-orbit convex interior transfer and dimension-16 Caratheodory then give exactly <=17 actual nonnegative observation times. An independently written checker confirmed the 64 positive weights, 32 second moments, mod109 affine rank16, and 64 numerical matrix entries (maximum error 1.67e-16), independently of the source program. This does not purport to explicitly construct physical times.
residual_risks: Independent numerical matrix checks are not exact cyclotomic proof; original exact projector identities and independent modular rank certificate support the finite algebra, and the universal claim rests on analytical identities.
The 17 actual times are existential and their magnitudes are unbounded; neither exact times nor smallest support is proved.

value.rationale: The existence of exact uniform randomized-time mixing on P8 is a natural motivated unresolved arithmetic case q=9 of the quantum path problem. Its exact (not approximate) convex realization with finite <=17 observation times is mathematically meaningful and could guide work on other dependent spectra. The alternative 64-grid construction independently verifies a related phase-geometry phenomenon, but the intrinsic significance of this now-known fact cannot restore originality to the submitted final theorem.
residual_risks: The standalone 64-point phase table adds no demonstrated improved physical-time bound or new graph; it is not evaluated as a separate original valuable theorem.

final_claim: On unweighted adjacency P8, there exists a probability law on <=17 nonnegative physical observation times with E|exp(itA)_ij|^2=1/8 for every i,j. The source supplies an exact positive 64-point phase-torus certificate with rank16.
limitations: No explicit physical-time support or time magnitude bound.
Prior published P8 theorem with identical <=17 support means the final theorem is not original.
